crossRefs.note: Isn’t your piety your confidence? Isn’t the integrity of your ways your hope?
What is my strength, that I should wait? What is my end, that I should be patient?
Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.
He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.

translations.web: where then is my hope? as for my hope, who will see it?
translations.bsb: where then is my hope? Who can see any hope for me?
translations.kjv: And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see
translations.asv: Where then is my hope? And as for my hope, who shall see it?
